kind: original heavy sci-fi shoulder-fired rocket launcher prop (visual game asset)
texture_source: public/assets/blender/textures/palette (the shared 1024px palette JPEGs applied by tools/blender/material-library.py; originals untouched)

hinge.axis: vertical pin (game +y) on the left flank; the gate node translation in torch.gltf is the single runtime source

build_time_checks.anchor_contract: muzzle plane, bore axis and exposed 0.0620 radius across the whole heat band, all four markers, the 0.175 sight line, the trigger blade and the arming lever home position are asserted against the runtime contract every build
build_time_checks.heat_band_clearance: no vertex other than the bore may enter the heat band
build_time_checks.coplanar_face_audit: rejects flush faces between parts, which z-fight once same-material parts merge into one draw call
build_time_checks.part_contact: every authored part must cross, nearly touch or sit inside another part; a group that only meets the model through empty space is reported as floating and fails the build
build_time_checks.gate_sweep: every evaluated gate vertex is swung about the vertical hinge line for theta 0..1.85 rad step 0.05: none may enter a body/mag/bolt/trigger volume, for theta >= 1.55 all must keep 0.055 from the bore axis, and at theta 0 the frozen venturi pieces must occupy their closed-pose bounds

limitations: Scalar metallic/roughness only: no baked normal, occlusion or roughness maps.
Single LOD; no mobile GPU profiling.
Hand fit is unverified: the grip and support palms sit on the contract points and the geometry is built around them, but no third-person pose test was run.
notes: Fresh design (study BULWARK): squared breech housing, half-cage braces, industrial panels and handles, a rocket nose peeking from the tube mouth.
The heat band stays bare 0.0620 tube: the runtime glow sleeve at 0.0625 and the support hand own that span.

The breech gate (venturi leaves) swings open sideways on a vertical pin on the left flank (game (-0.104, 0.075, -0.135), 1.75 rad, no slide) so the bore axis stays clear for the reload round; gate nodes ship hinge-local with the hinge as node translation.
Markings are modelled geometry, not a texture decal.
No loose rounds: the reload rocket is spawned procedurally by the runtime.
Flip-up ladder sights bracket the shared 0.175 sight line.
